The hospital has 1 000 beds.  
Initially \( \frac15 \times 1000 = 200 \) beds are occupied, so \(1000-200 = 800\) beds are free.  

Each day 50 new patients are admitted. Over two weeks (14 days) this adds  
\(50 \times 14 = 700\) patients, each taking a bed.  

Assuming no discharges, the number of free beds after two weeks is  

\(800 - 700 = 100\).

**Final answer: 100**
